quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side the arrow points to.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side the arrow points to.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Flaggers control traffic in construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in one direction only.
Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be entering from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a side road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic and allow workers or vehicles to cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, a right turn is not permitted.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on this hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. The road will split into two one-way sections separated by a median. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is near. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is beginning.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing is coming. Be careful where pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and tell you about upcoming hazards. This sign means a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Signs with orange backgrounds are:
questions.explanation: Orange is used only for construction and maintenance warning signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign means passing other vehicles is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that another road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is straight out to the side, it means you are turning left or moving left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing is coming. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Wait until any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: When you approach an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, let other traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see this sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows a law you must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign says left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: This sign means that:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What message is on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs warn drivers about no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let trains pass before you cross.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a right turn where this sign is posted. Making a right turn would be unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of an upcoming winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that road conditions can cause you to lose control. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond sign warns you of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of danger in or near construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity ahead. Be alert and ready for unexpected conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead, and you must obey their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows one way only. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn of work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on green to yield to oncoming traffic and turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic cross before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic cross before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians crossing your path pass first. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to drive safely through these curves.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. They tell you where to find rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This pentagon-shaped sign tells you that you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter at a low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means there is a low overpass ahead. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A traffic signal ahead is showing red.
A traffic signal ahead is broken.
A traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is closing. The right lane ends soon. Merge left.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is closing. The right lane ends soon. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you that the number of lanes ahead is decreasing. You need to merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic is moving in two directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is moving in two directions.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings warns drivers of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your brakes to avoid damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you that traffic will be merging from the right. Be prepared to let them safely merge into your lane.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use this lane to pass or for through traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign tells drivers that a railroad crossing is coming. Look for signs of trains approaching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or roadway go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing without a signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing without a signal, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see or hear one. Never try to drive faster than a train.

questions.question: An orange sign like this means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is put on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign means lanes are merging. Two lanes of traffic are becoming one lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. Making a left turn where this sign is posted is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns that the clearance is low.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk location. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They warn drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you to slow down and prepare for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers may use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the driver will slow down or stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely, check for pedestrians and cross traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles at any time.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it is a prohibition sign. It means the action shown is not allowed. Right turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules you must obey. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you about school zones and school crossings. Stay alert and prepare to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane use control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you may use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for traffic coming in. If the lane next to you is empty, move over.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
